STEMI_initial_treatment.summary: Uncertainty remains about optimal initial treatment for patients with a working diagnosis of STEMI. Infarct size and microvascular obstruction are the main determinants of long-term prognosis; interventions to limit infarct size are needed.
research_needs: Placebo-controlled trials of therapies given before PPCI with hard endpoints.
Translate cardioprotective therapies from experimental to clinical setting via adequately powered trials.

Acute-phase_management_of_patients_with_.summary: Key uncertainties around invasive strategy and timing in NSTE-ACS.
evidence_gaps: Comparison of routine versus selective invasive assessment in low-risk NSTE-ACS has not been adequately evaluated.
Optimal timing of invasive angiography in high-risk NSTE-ACS patients remains uncertain.
research_recommendations: Randomize low-risk patients to routine or selective invasive strategy.
RCTs testing different time intervals to perform angiography within the 72 h window after initial presentation.

Antithrombotic_therapy.summary: Multiple uncertainties about P2Y12 inhibitor pre-treatment, strategies for de-escalation guided by platelet function or genetic testing, and optimal long-term antithrombotic regimens after PCI in NSTE-ACS.
evidence_gaps: Whether pre-treatment with oral P2Y12 receptor inhibitors prior to ICA improves clinical outcomes in NSTE-ACS is uncertain.

Whether platelet function testing or genetic testing to guide de-escalation of oral P2Y12 receptor inhibitors after the first month of therapy following PCI improves clinical management and outcomes remains unclear.
The optimal long-term antithrombotic regimen in NSTE-ACS patients who have undergone PCI is unknown.
After stopping DAPT, head-to-head comparison based on superiority between aspirin and placebo before PPCI (context truncated on page) is required.
research_recommendations: Randomize patients to pre-treatment with oral P2Y12 receptor inhibitors or no pre-treatment prior to ICA.
Randomize ACS patients to prasugrel or ticagrelor, both without pre-treatment.
Prospectively test a strategy based on platelet function testing or genetic testing in patients who may benefit from de-escalating antithrombotic therapy.
RCTs evaluating the benefit–risk balance for ischaemic versus bleeding events for different durations of antithrombotic therapy.

genes.context: The guideline text discusses uncertainty whether pre-treatment with oral P2Y12 receptor inhibitors prior to ICA improves outcomes, and whether platelet function testing or genetic testing to guide de-escalation of oral P2Y12 inhibitors after PCI improves management.
